services.name: 2 HR 4TH OF JULY SUNSET CRUISE W/FIREWORKS
services.desc: Our special 4th of July cruise! Adults - $65 Children (ages 12 and under) - $55 Children (ages 3 and under) - free! 2 hours About Sit back and relax on our plush seats as you take in a gorgeous sunset on peaceful Lake Howard. You will explore a minimum of seven to nine lakes, see plenty of wildlife and take in the sights of our stunning lakeside scenery. Watch the sun slowly dip behind our ancient cypress trees, catch a glimpse of the many species of birds as they head back to their resting place and the night-time regulars begin their day! Then head on over to Lake Eloise to July 4th at 7:30 PM

On this tour you will experience the sun slowly dipping behind our ancient cypress trees, catching a glimpse of the many species of birds as they head back to their resting place and the night-time regulars begin their day! services.name: 1 HR TOUR OF THE CHAIN OF LAKES
services.desc: An introductory historical wildlife tour exploring 3 to 4 of our beautiful lakes on the chain. 1 hour About Relax, and enjoy a historical nature tour of our beautiful Chain of Lakes. This tour is perfect for people who just want to get out and test the waters, have a busy schedule, or for families with small children! Enjoy cruising by gorgeous lakeside homes and through some of our incredibly beautiful canals as your local guide shares the rich history of the lakes and uses their keen eye to spot the wildlife for you! You will encounter all types of native and non-native wildlife Available Daily

services.name: 2 HR TOUR OF THE CHAIN OF LAKES
services.desc: One of our most popular cruise options! Explore the wildlife, nature and history of 6 to 9 beautiful lakes! 2 hours About This option includes a beautiful tour of anywhere from six to nine lakes. (The amount of lakes you see will depend on how often you slow for wildlife pics, and there are plenty of opportunities!). You will learn about the rich history of Winter Haven, Cypress Gardens and Legoland. Are you a baseball fan? We will be cruising by the chain of lakes baseball complex, the former spring training grounds of the Boston Red Sox and the Cleveland Indians! Our local guides Available Daily

You could see the water turkeys mount on the docks and spread their wings to dry after hunting for fish, catch an owl as they head back tour their nest, and see many other species as they come alive with the rising sun. services.name: 3 HR LUNCH CRUISE
services.desc: A customer favorite! Great way to spend time with friends and family! 3 hours (2hrs touring 1hr stop for lunch) About The 3hr tour begins with a 1hr tour in one direction then back to restaurant for lunch and after lunch it departs in a different direction for the 2nd half of tour. (Departure and lunch times can be customized when available). This is a beautiful guided historical nature tour through 7 to 9 lakes and unique canals. On the 3hr you will tour for one hour before arriving at the famous Harborside restaurant on Lake Shipp where you will dine for an hour before re-boarding

services.name: EARLY BIRD DINNER CRUISE
services.desc: AVAILABLE SPRING AND SUMMER 3 hours About Our Early Bird Dinner cruise is beautiful time to be on the water as it is a little cooler. You will see plenty of wildlife, incredible ancient vegetation, gorgeous homes and stunning views! This cruise departs directly from Harborside and begins with a one hour tour through 3 to 4 lakes where you will experience the history and and wildlife of the famous Chain of Lakes. After the first hour you will return to Harborside where there will be a table waiting for you (usually by the window) where you will dine while the boat waits at the dock. Times vary. Select a date to see availabilities.

services.name: DAY TOUR W/STOP FOR LUNCH AT HARBORSIDE
services.desc: Spend the day on the chain of Lakes! This cruise is for those who would like to make a day of exploring the entire southern chain of Lakes in one day! Your cruise will depart at 10am and you will cruise for two hours starting at either Lake Summit or Lake Shipp depending on what day of the week your cruise is booked. Weekday cruises will start from Lake Summit and explore all the lakes on the southern portion of the tour first. Weekend cruises will start from Lake Shipp and begin with the northern lakes. After the first two hours you will stop for lunch at Harborside from 12:00 to 1:00pm Tour the entire southern chain with a stop at Harborside for lunch! Lunch cost not included.
